name: Meme skit
brief: The Vietnamese TikTok meme look: one still photo as the whole background, showing where the line happens (an office, a bedroom at night, a server room; npm run image -- <slug> "<place>"), changed only when the place changes. One or two meme animals acting out the line in the lower half: animated stickers from npm run meme -- <slug> "cat dancing" (or vibing, shocked, crying, typing), played with the kit Meme, big, mirrored when they face each other; green-screen footage with the kit GreenScreen only when no meme fits. At the top a big caption telling the situation in plain spoken Vietnamese with the kit MemeCaption (yellow, black outline), centred, at most 3 lines, replaced line by line. No other graphics, cards or icons; between captions a quick kit zoomPunch or flash, never a slow fade.
